name: Campingplatz Schliersee
beschreibung: The Schliersee campsite is located in the town of the same name in Tirol, Österreich. The surroundings are characterized by a quiet mountain landscape. The site has pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents, which are equipped with electrical connections. The facilities include sanitary facilities and a small shop. The atmosphere is thoroughly solid and close to nature. The target audience consists mainly of hikers and nature lovers. Those seeking relaxation appreciate the quiet location away from through roads.
